claims: Coachella attracts approximately 125,000 to 130,000 attendees per day.
Coachella is held over two weekends.
Coachella's total attendance exceeds 250,000 people per year combined.
Coachella is held at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.
Coachella's daily capacity is around 125,000 attendees, including fans, staff, and artists.
Coachella's two-weekend total often reaches or exceeds 250,000.
Coachella started with roughly 25,000 people in 1999.
Around 125,000 are on-site daily at Coachella.
Millions more watch Coachella performances via the YouTube livestream.
Coachella consistently sells out its capacity each year.
